records.name: PrivOS
records.tagline: Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks and Al agents that act, self-hosted
records.description: PrivOS is the all-in-one AI-native operating system for enterprise work. Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks (lists with table and Kanban views) and tailored MCP apps live in one place, and AI agents act on them: @-mention a list, file, folder or app in a room and the agent works on it from its own sandboxed container. Self-host the Community Edition free for up to 10 users (beta) or use our Cloud, hosted in the EU. Bring any Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible model, including local ones.

records.name: Koi
records.tagline: Every tool you need, in one Mac app
records.description: Most people pay for three tools: a dictation app, a meeting notetaker and an AI assistant. Koi is all three in one Mac app. Tap Fn + ⌥ and your words type into any app, offline and unlimited. Tap Fn + ⌘ and talk to an AI that sees your screen, points at things and does them for you. Tap Fn + ⌃ to record any call with no bot joining, then get notes and to-dos. It all lands as pages on your Mac. Try it free for 3 days.

records.name: AskDoozy
records.tagline: An AI coworker in Slack that does your real work
records.description: Doozy sits in your Slack. Someone mentions it in a thread with a real task ("why was Acme charged twice?", "post signups and churn to #leadership every Monday", "export last month's refunds by reason") and it goes and does it in your actual database, Stripe, GitHub, Linear, PostHog, HubSpot or anything with an API. The answer comes back in the thread with the files and a receipt for every action it took. One price per workspace, everyone included, 14 days free, no card.

records.name: Woven Video
records.tagline: Edit any video by chat, on a real Mac timeline
records.description: Woven is a full AI video editor for Mac. Import your footage, ask for the edit in chat, and fine-tune it on a real timeline, with captions, music, sound effects and generated shots. For YouTube videos, Shorts, podcasts and more.

records.name: BAND for Developers
records.tagline: Coding agents, meet teamwork
records.description: Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

records.name: Scout by Fini
records.tagline: The AI coworker for support teams, on Slack
records.description: Scout is an AI coworker for support teams, on Slack. Ask in plain language: it reads tickets, reviews and call transcripts, finds the pattern and drafts the fix. A person approves every change. Access is set up with the Fini team.

records.name: Tend
records.tagline: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs.
records.description: Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

records.name: NativeShip
records.tagline: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration
records.description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

records.name: UseIt Studio
records.tagline: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files.
records.description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

records.name: Needle
records.tagline: The agent-native outbound engine
records.description: Find your perfect leads and reach out by prompting Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok. Wherever your ICP are, on LinkedIn, Instagram, or email.

records.name: Intelli for ChatGPT & Claude
records.tagline: Run WhatsApp, Instagram & web chat from ChatGPT or Claude
records.description: Intelli is now a plugin in ChatGPT’s directory, and works in Claude and any MCP client. Ask in plain language and your AI assistant handles your WhatsApp, Instagram and website conversations: summarise unanswered chats, launch campaigns, build chatbot flows, update contacts and products. 89 tools, OAuth sign-in, no API keys. Nothing is sent, edited or deleted until you confirm. Also new: Instagram/Facebook comment & DM automation.

records.name: Lea by LeanAIOS
records.tagline: Autonomous AI team for construction management & pre-con
records.description: Meet Lea, the autonomous AI platform built specifically for construction GCs and PMs. With 18 specialized roles, Lea automates quantities takeoff, manages FIDIC contract notice deadlines, tracks 6-week lookahead schedules, and runs 3D site rehearsals.

records.name: ilha
records.tagline: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch
records.description: ilha is a native Mac app that lives in the notch (a small pill on other displays) and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build limits you've used: the 5-hour and weekly windows, when they reset, and whether you're on pace to run out. If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.

records.name: Mouse-1
records.tagline: A decision model for your agent harness.
records.description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

records.name: The Brains
records.tagline: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited
records.description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

records.name: TwinMind for Desktop
records.tagline: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
records.description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

records.name: Yarite
records.tagline: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone.
records.description: Yarite is an iPhone app that reminds you to reach out before it feels too late. Put each person in one of six circles, closest to furthest, each with its own rhythm. Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

records.name: Flyweel
records.tagline: Ad spend cards, cash-gap funding, and agent audit via MCP
records.description: Give your AI agent financial rails for paid ads. Issue virtual cards with custom spend caps, fund cash gaps so winning campaigns keep scaling while revenue catches up, and let your agent check charges against live ad results via MCP. Built for businesses that scale on paid ads.

records.name: The Library
records.tagline: Your business context organized by queries
records.description: The Querri Library is where your data gets organized around the questions your business asks, so every answer comes from the same trusted, shared foundation.. The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.

records.name: Flagsmith Experiments
records.tagline: Open-source A/B testing built on your feature flags
records.description: Flagsmith now runs A/B tests on the flags you already use. Pick a flag and a metric, and get a Bayesian read on which variant wins. Use our managed warehouse or bring your own ClickHouse or Databricks. Free and open source, self-hosted or cloud.

records.name: Hotly
records.tagline: Get paid to answer your DMs. Open source.
records.description: Your inbox, with a price on it. People pay to send you a note or subscribe weekly. You reply from one inbox, when it suits you, and Stripe pays you. Run it free on your own server, or let us host it: 30 days free.

records.name: Blooio
records.tagline: Apple Messages for Business made easy
records.description: As an Apple Messaging Service Provider, we enable verified, branded conversations inside Apple's Messages app, with quick replies, interactive forms, appointment scheduling, Apple Pay, and rich media. Connect your CRM, support team, or AI agents through one unified API, with RCS, SMS, and WhatsApp supported too. This is business messaging beyond blue bubbles. Same API you've been using for the past 2 years is now compatible with the official business channel!

records.name: Nimbalyst Wiki
records.tagline: Wiki your agents write for you to think, organize, direct
records.description: Overwhelmed and disorganized by Codex and Claude Code? Nimbalyst wiki is a local wiki your agents write for you so you can think, organize, and set direction Your agents organize decisions, open questions, and the big picture into a wiki you can edit visually. It is a free plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP agent. No app or account needed. Pages are plain markdown, drawing, csv, clickable html files in your repo, and Claude opens them in your browser for editing.

records.name: Burrow MacOS
records.tagline: Start Windows & Linux on your Mac for free
records.description: Instantly run Windows 11 or any Linux on your Mac with one click and absolutely for free. Save Your money.

records.name: LearnExcel
records.tagline: Learn Excel by typing real formulas, graded instantly
records.description: LearnExcel teaches Excel by doing, not watching. Each exercise is a small spreadsheet and a task: you type the formula in your browser and it's graded instantly, and any formula that really works is accepted. 280+ exercises from SUM and IF to INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables and NPV/IRR, 40+ free function guides, and a 7-day plan plus a timed mock test for Excel job-interview tests. Free to start, no signup, in 6 languages.

records.name: Notion Auto
records.tagline: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less
records.description: Notion’s Agents update rebuilds the agent harness so tasks can run for 24 hours or more, with a computer, a browser and a Review for me safety mode. Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

records.name: Agent Pets
records.tagline: Coding agents as pets that live on every page in Chrome
records.description: Each Claude Code, OpenCode and omp session becomes a pet that walks along the bottom of Chrome. See which agent needs you, approve its commands and reply from any tab. Runs on your computer: no account, no cloud. $6 one-time.

records.name: hibi
records.tagline: an open-source obsidian alternative
records.description: Hibi is a free, open-source desktop writing and note-taking app designed for individuals seeking more control over their document organization and creation. It is an alternative to apps like Obsidian and Joplin, combining standard knowledge management features with a flexible editing experience that surpasses markdown.

records.name: Triage by Chodeberg
records.tagline: Reproduce user described bugs in clean sandbox environments
records.description: Customers file bugs from their AI assistant into a live copy of your app. Triage replays each report on a clean machine and sends you the ones that break again.

records.name: iglass
records.tagline: Liquid Glass for your iTerm2 & Ghostty
records.description: A free, open-source theme for iTerm2 and Ghostty on macOS and Linux. Real Liquid Glass in Ghostty on macOS 26, four glass levels, eight accents, light & dark. Every color is contrast-checked, and every change is reversible with one command.

records.name: Animatica Marionette
records.tagline: Pose humanoid rigs in Blender by dragging hands and feet
records.description: Animatica Marionette is a neural control rig for Blender: drag a hand, a foot or the hips and the whole body follows. Marionette allows editing FK motion directly in Blender. It runs on your machine, in about 15 ms a pose, on Mixamo, Unreal and other humanoid rigs as they are.

records.name: How to Start Investing With $100
records.tagline: How to Start Investing With $100: Beginner Guide (2026)
records.description: New to investing? Learn how to start small, choose simple low-cost funds, avoid common mistakes and build a habit. For education only, no jargon

records.name: Simple English Dictionary
records.tagline: Double-click any word on any webpage for instant definitions
records.description: Double-click any word on any webpage for instant definitions, IPA phonetics, and audio pronunciations in an elegant, isolated floating card. Zero tracking.

records.name: Echonos
records.tagline: Music
records.description: Echonos is an AI music video generator for artists. Upload a song, pick the moment, and Echonos builds a beat synced music video in 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1. Release Package turns your cover into cover art takes, a Spotify Canvas loop and an animated cover.

records.name: Smart Diet Pro
records.tagline: web-based dietary planning application.
records.description: Smart Diet Pro is an intelligent, web-based dietary planning application engineered to bridge the gap between clinical nutrition and everyday lifestyle management. Unlike generic calorie counters, Smart Diet Pro utilizes a rule-based AI engine to generate highly personalized meal plans. It factors in physical metrics (BMI, TDEE), fitness goals (Loss, Maintenance, Gain), and specific medical conditions (Diabetes, Thyroid, Kidney Disease, etc.).

records.name: Hold Sleep
records.tagline: Close the lid. Work keeps going. Mac sleeps when done.
records.description: Hold Sleep keeps your Mac awake only while real work is running: AI agents like Claude Code, big downloads, video exports and builds. It works even with the lid closed and lets your Mac sleep again the moment the work is done. No timers, no toggles.

records.name: Msgy
records.tagline: The free link in bio made for 18+ creators
records.description: One free page for your OnlyFans, Fansly, wishlists and socials. Make it yours with photos and themes, add 18+ notices, and see where fans come from and which links they tap. No ads. No other creators on your page.

records.name: Nomback
records.tagline: Your restaurant’s own ordering app, no commission
records.description: Nomback gives an independent restaurant its own iPhone and Android ordering and rewards app, under their name in the App Store. Customers order and pay in the app, earn stamps, and get free items the owner picks. Orders print in the kitchen or land on the owner’s Clover already paid. $99 a month, no commission, versus the 25 to 30% DoorDash takes. Type any restaurant’s name on nomback.com and see its app in about 10 seconds.

records.name: CS2 Storage Unit Manager
records.tagline: Manage CS2 Storage Units from Chrome
records.description: Opening CS2 just to move a few items in/out of storage units is an added friction. Use the CS2 Storage Unit Manager Chrome extension to do the job with 0 hassle, no need to open CS2 for every time you want to remove one skin or item to list on market or give it to a friend for use. View, deposit, withdraw and rename all from 1 extension.

records.name: bolipi
records.tagline: Voice typing for Mac with no server to time out
records.description: Hold fn and talk. Your words appear live, get cleaned up when you let go (punctuation in, ums out, "no wait" corrections applied) and paste into any app. Everything runs on your Mac, offline. No account, no telemetry.

records.name: HaulierScope
records.tagline: Check any GB operator licence, and see what changed
records.description: Check Great Britain goods vehicle and PSV operator licences and see changes between published DVSA files. Free lookup pages bring licence, company and regulatory context together with source dates. Developers get a free JSON API and 15 read-only MCP tools, with no account or API key. Optional paid monitoring adds alerts. Built by Luli Labs Limited; independent of DVSA and the Traffic Commissioners.

records.name: Solo Era
records.tagline: Do things alone. Level up your confidence.
records.description: Solo Era turns doing things alone into a game. Every week you get one mission, like going to the cinema or a café by yourself. Rate your fear before and after, finish it, earn XP and level up. Your fear curve shows you getting braver over time. Unlike habit trackers, it’s built around one thing: confidence. Journal with photos, streaks and playful haptics keep you coming back. Built solo, for iOS.

records.name: iSonic
records.tagline: iSonic – Empowering Creators with AI.
records.description: iSonic is where creators get their content indexed so AI can cite it. iSonic turns a creator's existing content into a public question and answer library that AI search engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity can find, understand and cite. It works automatically, at no cost to the creator. iSonic was founded by Ankesh Kumar. Learn more at isonic.ai.

records.name: Thymi :AI Calorie tracker & Food planner
records.tagline: Track calories by snapping your plate.
records.description: Thymi is a calorie tracker and food diary for iPhone. Snap a photo of your meal, scan a barcode or type what you ate, and get calories, protein, carbs and fat in seconds, checked against USDA data. Free to start.

records.name: Gradsey
records.tagline: Saves your Stripe money
records.description: Reads your Stripe account with a read-only key and names the customers slipping away: scheduled cancellations, failed payments by decline code, annual renewals and silent churn and you can also craft a custom daily mail that informs you about your money slipping away Why not Baremetrics/ProfitWell/Churnkey? They're built with overwhelming ammount of features. Gradsey is for the little guy: Stripe only, one-minute setup, nothing to install, just a short list of people to email today.

records.name: AI Signature Generators
records.tagline: Create signature images with 109 handwriting fonts
records.description: Create signature images using 109 handwriting fonts and download PNG, JPG, image-based SVG, or PDF files in your browser.

records.name: TanjiroAI
records.tagline: Private AI on your iPhone
records.description: TanjiroAI is a personal assistant that runs on your iPhone, with optional help from your own Mac. There is no account to make and nothing to sign up for. After its downloads, ordinary iPhone chat works even in airplane mode. FREE: YOUR ASSISTANT • Chat with Tanjiro. Pick Tanjiro-Tiny for the quickest answers, Tanjiro-Speed for a balance, or Tanjiro-Quality for deeper ones. • Memory you control: save facts explicitly, and let Tanjiro recall relevant earlier chats. Turn "Remember past chats"...

records.name: Adawati - Private Online Tools
records.tagline: Privacy-first tools that never upload your files
records.description: 100% Private: All processing happens locally in your browser using modern web tech. Your files NEVER touch our servers. Instant Results: No upload/download waiting times. Completely Free: No subscriptions, no ads, no registration. Bilingual: Full Arabic & English support. Tools include: PDF merge/split/compress, image compression, AI background removal, video trimming, and more. Try it: https://jopfind.com

records.name: Joint Pain Treatment in KPHB
records.tagline: Joint Pain Treatment in KPHB
records.description: Searching for the best doctor for joint pain? Consult Dr. G Gopi Krishna Reddy at Dr. Gopi’s Specialty Clinics, offering personalized care for arthritis, sports injuries, and chronic joint pain with advanced orthopedic treatment. Book your consultation today!

records.name: ExamParser
records.tagline: Convert Word, PDF & Docs to a Canvas Quiz
records.description: Want to convert Word, PDF & Docs to a Canvas Quiz without rebuilding every question by hand? Upload any document — Word, PDF, Google Docs or Google Sheets. ExamParser takes every question apart — number, stem, options, answer key — and writes it straight into Canvas, Moodle, Quizizz, Blackboard, Kahoot or Google Forms. Pick one platform or several.

records.name: Vocalace
records.tagline: American pronunciation practice for Chinese speakers
records.description: 示范音频 + Azure 逐音素纠错，专为中文母语者设计。

records.name: Zavik
records.tagline: Prep any repo to run. Audit it before it runs.
records.description: Zavik is an open-source dev CLI & AI-orchestration engine. One call detects your stack and briefs any AI coding agent — runbook, entrypoints, trust (zavik context --json). Another audits your dependency supply chain and gates PRs via a GitHub Action with SARIF output. Plain CLI: stable --json and exit codes are the interface — works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or no agent at all. Free forever (MIT core); the paid add-on is a daily signed risk dataset, never locked features.

records.name: BlurPilot
records.tagline: Auto-blur emails, API keys & client data on screen shares
records.description: BlurPilot is a Chrome extension that auto-blurs sensitive data on any web page before anyone sees it. Press Alt+Shift+H and emails, phone numbers, card numbers, IBANs, API keys, IP addresses and client names blur on every tab. Screen share on Zoom, Google Meet or Teams, run sales demos and record tutorials without leaking customer data. Click to blur any element and save rules per site. 100% local: no page content leaves your browser. Free plan, plus a 7-day Pro trial with no card.

records.name: Deep Breath Plus
records.tagline: Guided breathing you can follow with your eyes closed
records.description: Most of us open a breathing app at the exact moment we can least handle friction: before a presentation, at 2am, in a hospital waiting room. Too often the first breath comes after onboarding, a mood quiz, a sign-up and a trial offer. Deep Breath Plus starts in one tap, and gives inhale, hold and exhale each their own vibration, so you can follow along with your eyes closed or the screen off. Free, no account, records stay on your device. Some screens show ads, never mid-session.

records.name: Display Tips
records.tagline: Show Venmo, Cash App and PayPal tips on stream
records.description: Display Tips shows Venmo, Cash App and PayPal tips on stream, so viewers who support a creator directly can still get a thank-you on screen. Works before platform monetization. One overlay, a flat subscription, and no Display Tips percentage cut.

records.name: Loom
records.tagline: See what your local coding agents are doing on your Mac
records.description: A native macOS menu-bar app for monitoring Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity. Correlate sessions with repositories, inspect lifecycle and provider health, and view usage where supported. Local-first, read-only, free and MIT open source.

records.name: vCISO
records.tagline: Expert cybersecurity leadership, on-demand.
records.description: CISO Lead’s CISO-as-a-Service provides on-demand cybersecurity leadership and strategy for organizations without a full-time CISO. The service covers comprehensive risk assessments, security governance, cloud security optimization (AWS, M365, Google Workspace), and incident response planning. It also ensures compliance with regulations like GDPR and ISO 27001, while boosting workforce resilience through employee security awareness training, phishing simulations, and regular executive reporting.

records.name: Aitopkit
records.tagline: Discover 121+ free AI tools — reviews, comparisons, guides
records.description: Aitopkit is a free AI tools directory with 121+ hand-reviewed tools, side-by-side comparisons, 270+ prompts, and daily AI news. No sign-up needed.

records.name: Behance
records.tagline: Creation
records.description: Julian Estes on Behance

records.name: Water Damage Restoration
records.tagline: Water Damage Restoration
records.description: Professional water damage restoration services for fast water removal, structural drying, and moisture control to help prevent mould growth and restore your property safely and efficiently.

records.name: stemline101
records.tagline: Split any song into stems
records.description: Stemline101 splits any song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar and more, then lets you mix stems from different songs on one mixer. Free to start.

records.name: The Bomb Sweeper
records.tagline: Minesweeper, Chess & Puzzles
records.description: The Bomb Sweeper takes Minesweeper in four directions: reveal safe squares in Classic, move chess pieces through minefields in Chesssweeper, place mines to satisfy clues in Mineplacer, and solve handcrafted Puzzle Chambers. It’s available on iPhone and iPad, with free starter content in every mode and no ads. One optional purchase unlocks the remaining challenges.

records.name: Vanza: Invoice & Estimate Maker
records.tagline: Invoice maker, estimates & legal contracts with E-Sign
records.description: Offline-first mobile invoice maker and estimate generator for contractors, freelancers, and small businesses. Create clean PDF estimates, generate branded invoices, protect your work with signed contracts, and collect client signatures on-site directly on your phone.

records.name: Gift Card
records.tagline: Free Gift Card
records.description: 🎨 **Great ideas deserve great support.** Give the **Creative Studio Pass Gift Card**—perfect for creators, entrepreneurs, and dreamers. ✨ Buy a **$100 Gift Card** and get **$15 Bonus Credit** for a limited time! 🎁 Inspire creativity today. 🔗 Get Your Gift Card: **[YOUR WEBSITE LINK]** 👉 Visit the website now to learn more.

records.name: Redaxa
records.tagline: Privacy check for AI prompts and public GitHub repos
records.description: Redaxa finds personal data, credentials, financial info and secrets in your AI prompt before you send it, inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Perplexity. Plus a free read-only check of public GitHub repos for leaked keys. Web, Chrome, Windows.

records.name: MockShot
records.tagline: Turn screenshots into 2D, 3D, and video mockups.
records.description: MockShot turns screenshots into polished 2D images, 3D device renders, and animated mockups in your browser. Choose phone, tablet, or laptop frames, customize backgrounds and layouts, and fine-tune angles and animation keyframes. Start free with 2D exports and watermarked 3D images. Pro unlocks watermark-free 3D images and video exports.

records.name: Molwee
records.tagline: Save links from any app. Get reminded.
records.description: Molwee is an iPhone and iPad bookmark app that brings your saves back. Share a link from any app (Safari, YouTube, X, Reddit) and Molwee keeps it with its title and preview. A home-screen widget, a "Worth revisiting" row and a weekly digest resurface older links. Collections, tags, notes, search, bulk edit; light/dark mode. Import from Pocket, browser bookmarks or CSV, export any time. No account: your links stay on your phone. Free; one-time Pro adds reminders, saved article text and search.

records.name: rootbeer
records.tagline: A native macOS app for managing Homebrew packages.
records.description: A native macOS app for managing Homebrew packages. Browse installed formulae and casks with their icons, upgrade them, and uninstall them along with dependencies nothing else needs. Swift and SwiftUI, built with Swift Package Manager. No Xcode project, no third-party dependencies, no web views. How to install? brew tap prethammuthappa/rootbeer https://github.com/PrethamMuthappa/rootbeer brew trust --formula prethammuthappa/rootbeer/rootbeer brew install rootbeer

records.name: Side Calendar for Windows
records.tagline: Your calendar at the edge of your Windows screen
records.description: Push your mouse to the edge of the screen and your calendar slides into view. Side Calendar for Windows shows Outlook, Google, iCloud and CalDAV calendars, lets you time-block by dragging, and joins Teams, Zoom or Meet calls in one click.

records.name: Gydmation AI
records.tagline: Describe an automation, get a real n8n workflow
records.description: Describe an automation in plain English and Gydmation writes the real n8n workflow. It picks from 1,100+ n8n nodes, checks each against real n8n schemas, asks when something is unclear and deploys to your n8n in one click. Self-hosted in Docker: your workflows and n8n credentials stay on your machine, and it never asks you to paste API keys into a chat. Free with your own AI key; Pro adds Claude models with nothing to set up.

records.name: WiselyFound
records.tagline: Hand-picked Amazon favorites across 6 essential categories.
records.description: wiselyfound cuts through the noise of endless Amazon listings by curating the best-rated items across 6 distinct categories: House, Garden, Kitchen, Decor, and more. We strictly vet products for true quality and value so you don't have to. Instead of spending hours comparing reviews and dodging low-quality sellers, you get a clean, optimized layout of reliable products, saving you time and helping you buy with confidence.

records.name: Page Mix
records.tagline: Shopify theme remix. Clone any web page in shopify
records.description: Page Mix builds Shopify landing pages from pages you already like: give it a layout reference and a style reference, and it adds an original, editable page to your own Shopify theme.

records.name: Registro Student Exchange by EDTEX
records.tagline: Incoming and outgoing student exchange in one place
records.description: Registro EPAS runs incoming and outgoing student exchange in one place: partner factsheets, applications, seat allocation, credit transfer and pre-departure preparation. Students compare partners, apply and track their status live, with oversubscribed seats allocated through transparent bid-point rounds. The international office manages agreements, course equivalencies and reports without spreadsheets. From EDTEX, trusted by around 40 institutions including ISB, SDA Bocconi and leading IIMs.

records.name: The Deck Cauldron
records.tagline: Collect, organize, build, and playtest your MTG decks

records.name: Webwise AI Employees

records.name: Coach Sygn

records.tagline: Convert files without opening an app. Drag, tap Shift, done.

records.name: NativeShip

records.description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

records.name: UseIt Studio
records.tagline: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files.
records.description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

records.name: PhotoPoem: Poems by People
records.tagline: Creative, poetry, social
records.description: PhotoPoem turns your photos into poetry. Snap or upload a photo and let PhotoPoem write an original poem inspired by what it sees. Pick a style and a mood, then weave the words and image into a piece of art you can share. Whether you write every day or just want to see your photos turned into verse, PhotoPoem is a calm, beautiful place for words and images to meet.

records.name: Needle
records.tagline: The agent-native outbound engine
records.description: Find your perfect leads and reach out by prompting Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok. Wherever your ICP are, on LinkedIn, Instagram, or email.

records.name: Intelli for ChatGPT & Claude
records.tagline: Run WhatsApp, Instagram & web chat from ChatGPT or Claude
records.description: Intelli is now a plugin in ChatGPT’s directory, and works in Claude and any MCP client. Nothing is sent, edited or deleted until you confirm. Also new: Instagram/Facebook comment & DM automation.

records.name: Lea by LeanAIOS
records.tagline: Autonomous AI team for construction management & pre-con
records.description: Meet Lea, the autonomous AI platform built specifically for construction GCs and PMs. With 18 specialized roles, Lea automates quantities takeoff, manages FIDIC contract notice deadlines, tracks 6-week lookahead schedules, and runs 3D site rehearsals.

records.name: ilha

If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.

records.name: Mouse-1
records.tagline: A decision model for your agent harness.
records.description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

records.name: The Brains

Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

records.name: TwinMind for Desktop

With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

records.name: Mandu
records.tagline: Keeps your secrets from your AI agent, and keeps it useful

records.name: Yarite

Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

records.name: Flyweel
records.tagline: Ad spend cards, cash-gap funding, and agent audit via MCP

Built for businesses that scale on paid ads.

records.name: The Library

The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.

records.name: Flagsmith Experiments

records.name: Vorisy

Sellers see showings, feedback and next steps wihout texting the agent. Buyers see every closing dat in one timeline. It is not e-signature or transactin management, so it works next to dotloop or SkySlop. Social Studio by Reclearly adds post planning and cheduling.

records.name: Quietstack
records.tagline: The monthly close chase, run for you
records.description: One job, and nothing else: it asks your clients for the items they still owe you for the month, and it asks again on day 3, 7 and 14 counted from the first reminder, for anything still open. All of it without you writing a chase email. Each client gets one email listing their own open items, with your firm's name on it. It is not a portal invitation and there is nothing in it to click. One page shows who still owes what. $50 a month, flat. No call, no demo, no onboarding.

records.name: Textspeed
records.tagline: Textspeed technology offers SMS,WhatsApp,RCS,Voice,Email
records.description: Create automated email journeys based on customer actions, segments and timing. Textspeed helps teams nurture contacts with consistent communication.

records.name: ToolsBench
records.tagline: 190+ free tools for PDFs, images and code. No sign-up
records.description: ToolsBench is 190+ free tools for everyday file jobs: compress images, merge and split PDFs, convert HEIC to JPG, trim video, format JSON and more. What makes it different: most tools run entirely in your browser, so your files are not uploaded to a server. No sign-up, no watermarks and no "upgrade to download". The few tools that need an outside service (like IP lookup) say so clearly. Built by a solo developer in Karachi.

records.name: SportyPlus
records.tagline: Club management for any sport
records.description: SportyPlus runs a sports club in one app: court booking, memberships, payments and invoices, leagues, tournaments and ELO ladders, plus smart locks and lighting. iOS, Android and web, in 18 languages. Players never pay; clubs start with three months free.

records.name: Ombuto Code
records.tagline: From requirements to running code. Autonomously.
records.description: Coding agents write code fast, but someone still has to prompt, wait and check. Ombuto Code takes you out of that loop. It is an open-source desktop workbench that lives in your repo. Write a PRD, architecture and tickets with an agent, each ticket with acceptance criteria. Switch on the scheduler and agents build, test and fix in a loop while an evaluation agent checks the result against the criteria. Review the report, run summary and diff. Works with Claude Code, Codex and Kimi. Apache 2.0.

records.name: JumpDock
records.tagline: One-click menu bar access to the settings macOS buries
records.description: Every Mac setting is three clicks away and the one you want is always the third. JumpDock puts them in your menu bar: privacy sections, settings panes, utilities, your own apps and folders. Including the Gatekeeper setting macOS gives no direct link to. And for audio, every output and microphone gets its own volume slider and mute, acting on that device whether or not it's the current one. Scroll over a device's menu bar icon to change its level.

records.name: InboxWire
records.tagline: Disposable test inboxes with an API built for CI
records.description: Receive-only disposable email addresses with a live inbox in the browser and a REST API for automated email-verification testing. Creates throwaway addresses on demand, strips tracking pixels, extracts one-time passcodes, and deletes everything on expiry.

records.name: FieldFoxx
records.tagline: Run your service based business from one simple app
records.description: Scheduling, dispatch, CRM, quotes, invoicing, and online payments for small lawn care, landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and cleaning businesses. QuickBooks Online and Mailchimp sync. Weather-day rescheduling with client text or email notices, and skip or pause visits.

records.name: Wishlyr
records.tagline: Stop impulse buying. Save it, wait, then decide.
records.description: Wishlyr helps you stop impulse buying and overspending. Start a no-buy challenge, save what you want, wait, then buy it or skip it. Block shopping apps, reflect on purchases and see what you skipped. No bank link, free on iPhone.

records.name: TraderWAI
records.tagline: Tell your AI «buy gold below yesterday's low». Done.
records.description: Tell your AI «buy gold below yesterday's low». It tests the idea on real prices first: as written, it lost −2.9R over the last 30 days; waiting for the 1-hour candle to close back above made +7.1R (13 trades, 62% won). Say «use that one, risk 0.5%» and it's done: the rule runs every minute on your own broker account (MetaTrader, cTrader, TradeLocker and more), with your stop and your risk. Works with ChatGPT, Claude and Grok. Free to start.

records.name: appassistai
records.tagline: https://appassistai.org
records.description: I just launched AppassistAI — an AI tool that helps job seekers land more interviews. Upload your resume, paste a job description, and it instantly: Tailors your resume to the role (no invented experience) Writes a matching cover letter in your choice of tone Scores your match and shows missing keywords Prepares interview questions and thank-you emails Works in 50+ languages

records.name: NightEar - Snore & Sleep Log
records.tagline: Sound diary of your night. Snoring and quiet stretches.
records.description: NightEar records the room all night. In the morning it shows snoring and longer quiet stretches where no breathing sound was heard — moments people sometimes review when looking into possible sleep apnea. You set how long a silence has to be. Play any moment back with a spectrogram. Results only in the morning. Recordings stay on your phone, encrypted. No account. Not a medical device and does not diagnose apnea. First 50: 30-day Premium code MMWH-7A34-KX7A

records.name: Aient
records.tagline: AI DevOps colleague: detects bugs, opens PRs, verifies fixes
records.description: Tests pass, deploys go green, and something still breaks quietly in production. Most users never report it; they leave. Aient reads your traces, logs and metrics together with your code, turns thousands of events into one problem, finds the cause and opens a pull request with the fix. You merge it. Aient then checks in production that the error is gone. EUR 15 starter credit, no card required.

records.name: VRHow: VR Compatibility & Tools.
records.tagline: VR compatibility checks, headset tools, and interactive labs
records.description: VRHow helps you check PC VR compatibility, compare headsets, explore game requirements, and learn how VR hardware works through interactive labs. Free tools and source-linked guides, all in one place.

records.name: MiniTravels
records.tagline: Discover small towns near you.
records.description: Every town has a story. MiniTravels turns nearby towns and hidden gems into guided walking tours with AI-generated stories, audio narration and fascinating facts. Explore with friends, track your journey with Live Activities, discover bite-sized Stories and collect beautiful souvenir postcards. Your travels stay saved in the app. Private by design, with on-device AI support and free daily credits. Available in English, Italian and Spanish. Small places, big stories!

records.name: Infinity Remix
records.tagline: Remix any game with one sentence. AI rebuilds it in seconds
records.description: Infinity Remix is an arcade where you remix your own games. Pick a game, write one sentence about what should change, and AI rewrites it into your own playable version in seconds. Every remix is crash-tested and safety-checked before you play, and you can share it with a link or remix someone else's remix. First up: QUIRK SHOT, a physics game where every level breaks one rule, plus three arcade classics. Free in your browser, no sign-up.

records.name: Mixtape HQ
records.tagline: Turn your brand personality into a curated music playlist
records.description: Music tells you more about a brand's soul than any mission statement. Mixtape HQ lets companies and individuals express who they are through a curated playlist. Type a company name, pick your format to set the room (cassette, CD, streaming, phone playlist) and get a mix that captures the vibe. A culture deck for your startup. A mood board that plays. A vibe check for your brand. Your playlist is your personality.

records.name: Our Family Album
records.tagline: Share children’s photos privately with family.
records.description: Share children’s photos privately with family. Create albums on iPhone or iPad. Relatives can view shared browser links without an app or account.

records.name: Brandhunt
records.tagline: Decode any company's brand in seconds.
records.description: Brandhunt decodes any company's entire brand footprint — identity, social reach, leadership, competitors and financials, in seconds.

records.name: LosslessDrop
records.tagline: Batch compress images locally with zero cloud uploads.
records.description: Batch compress your images locally. Zero cloud uploads, zero file caps, 100% privacy.Meet LosslessDrop—a lightning-fast, beautifully minimal offline desktop...

records.name: Powerup Packs
records.tagline: Turn your assistant into an expert with one sentence
records.description: Every AI coach I tried was a generic chatbot agreeing with everything I typed. Powerup Packs installs an expert instead. One sentence, a short onboarding, and Muse becomes a marathon coach, a macro coach, a prayer keeper who actually knows you. Eleven experts, $19 each, yours forever. And they share notes. My training log feeds Macro Chef every morning, so the nutrition expert builds on what the training expert did. Train and Fuel, one system, zero re-explaining.

records.name: Byblos AI - Astra D
records.tagline: Astra D - Your AI Director within Byblos AI
records.description: Your AI Co-Founder. Product, brand, and campaign management in one platform + access to vetted human experts. Co-CTO for strong engineering foundations coming soon.

records.name: Repluma
records.tagline: Better words, right where you write
records.description: Repluma transforms selected text directly in any macOS or Windows app. Use a global shortcut to rewrite, summarize, translate, or run your own AI actions, then replace the selection in place. Choose Repluma Cloud, OpenAI, Apple Intelligence, or a local LM Studio model. No copy-paste, no context switching.

records.name: Resume Tailor
records.tagline: Tailor your resume to every job, and see what changed
records.description: Paste a job description and your resume. Resume Tailor rewrites it for that role and shows exactly what changed: original and tailored versions side by side, matched keywords highlighted, and an ATS score before and after. It also writes a cover letter and interview prep (STAR answers) using only your real experience, never invented achievements, and tracks every application with follow-up nudges. Export to DOCX, PDF, MD or TXT. Free to try.

records.name: Hinode
records.tagline: JLPT prep that explains every answer, N5 to N1
records.description: Most JLPT practice hands you an answer key and nothing else. Hinode explains every one of its 17,000+ questions (N5 to N1) in plain English, so each mistake actually teaches you something. Take timed mock tests, then retry what you got wrong for free until it sticks. Stats reveal your weak spots; a leaderboard and achievements keep you going. Start with 300 free questions plus free daily coins, and browse the full kanji list, vocab and grammar notes free, no account needed.

records.name: Calcus
records.tagline: More than a calculator
records.description: # Calcus – More Than a Calculator Meet **Calcus**, your all-in-one calculator and everyday utility companion. From scientific mathematics and financial planning to travel cost estimation, fuel prices, and currency conversion, Calcus brings essential tools together in one convenient app. ## 🧮 Powerful Calculations Perform everyday arithmetic and advanced mathematical calculations with ease. Speak your calculations instead of typing them for a convenient, hands-free experience.

records.name: Population Decides
records.tagline: Set the UK Budget yourself, with real figures
records.description: A free, non-partisan UK politics game. Answer six big questions or set every tax and department line by line, then see what your Budget does to borrowing, growth and seven real-life households. On 28 October, see how many of the Chancellor's calls you matched. There's also a five-year term mode: handle crises, face PMQs and try to get re-elected.

records.name: Claude Notifications
records.tagline: Get pinged when Claude Code finishes or needs you
records.description: A Claude Code plugin that sends hook events (task finished, waiting on your input, a tool you care about was used) to Slack, Discord, email, WhatsApp, desktop voice and web push. Walk away from long runs without missing the moment.

records.name: Robot Finder by RoboVerdict
records.tagline: Answer a few questions, get the robots that fit your home
records.description: Robot Finder is the part of the site I care about most. You pick what the robot should do (vacuum, mow, clean a pool or clean windows) and answer a few plain questions about your home. Every option shows how many robots it leaves, so you never end up with an empty list. You get every machine that meets every requirement you set, best Verdict Score first, and each match shows why it fits, using figures from the maker's own shop page, spec sheet or manual.

records.name: Logo to Stickers
records.tagline: Give your logo a character, a job, and a tiny accident
records.description: Turn your logo into a cast of paper sticker characters. Open-source Codex skill with 15 real examples, original logos, exact prompts and transparent PNGs. Bring an image-generation tool; provider costs apply.

records.name: korli
records.tagline: One link that adapts to every visitor. Built to sell.
records.description: Korli is a smart link-in-bio that adapts to each visitor in real time. Smart Rules change your page based on traffic source, country, time, or visitor type — no code needed. Built-in CRM, push notifications, forms, products (0% commission), newsletter, and analytics with revenue attribution. One plan at €19/mo replaces 4 tools. GDPR-native, hosted in France. No tiers, no per-seat pricing. Built solo by an indie founder from Belgium.

records.name: Zetfeed
records.tagline: Your own feed, built from the sources you choose
records.description: Zetfeed is a feed reader you build yourself. Add RSS, news sites, blogs, YouTube channels, Bluesky accounts, podcasts and newsletters that publish a feed, or import OPML from your old reader. Read them as a list, a magazine or one story at a time. Local news and weather, five daily games, and no ads or trackers. Native on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, plus Android and the web. Free for up to 20 sources, and every new account automatically gets 30 days of Member free.

records.name: IconMarvel
records.tagline: Search, customize, and ship SVG & PNG icons faster
records.description: IconMarvel is an AI-powered SVG and PNG icon platform for designers and developers. Discover icons with semantic search, browse categories, preview and customize colors, gradients, rotation, scale, and more. Export SVG/PNG files or copy code for React, Vue, and HTML. Integrate icons into your workflow with the developer API, NPM packages, CDN delivery, and Figma plugin. Built to simplify the journey from icon discovery and design to development.

records.name: StreamOps
records.tagline: Keep your livestream running with cloud or hybrid setups
records.description: Automate 24/7 YouTube live streams with StreamOps — schedule playlists, monitor streams remotely, auto-recover failures, and manage multiple channels on StreamOps Cloud or your own Windows or Linux PC.

records.name: Coco
records.tagline: Track subscriptions. Get reminded before you're charged
records.description: Coco is a calm, simple subscription tracker with no bank connection. You add each subscription yourself (pick one from about 200 popular services, or create your own) and see what you pay each month and the day each charge lands. Coco reminds you before each charge, so a payment you forgot about doesn't catch you off guard. When you cancel one, it shows how much you've saved. Available in 40 European countries for now, with more to come.

records.name: video2ctx
records.tagline: Turn videos into context for your agents
records.description: video2ctx makes videos queryable for AI agents. Search and inspect videos, get answers cited to the second, monitor channels, and save moments into projects. Use it through agent skills, CLI, API, npm package, or try our video agent directly. Open source with 1,000 free credits for everyone.

records.name: Free Background Remover
records.tagline: Remove backgrounds, fine-tune edges, get a PNG. Free
records.description: Most free background removers give you one click and no control. This one adds real editing tools. Use Auto Remove, Color Remove or Magic Wand with adjustable tolerance. Then clean up with an Eraser and Restore brush, and smooth the edges with Feather, Expand and Contract. Compare before and after, zoom in, and undo or redo any step. You can download a transparent PNG or fill the background with any color. It supports PNG, JPG and GIF up to 10MB. No watermark mentioned, no signup.

records.name: Spanish Rap AI
records.tagline: Turn one portrait into a Spanish rap performance
records.description: Turn one portrait into a Spanish rap video with expressive gestures and newly generated sound. Choose Close-Up Freestyle (9s) or Club Cypher (15s), then create a 720p vertical MP4 with no prompt, lyrics or recording required. Preview and download your take. Paid credits required; review the quote before generating. By VidMake AI. Previews are reference performances; likeness, lyrics and lip timing may vary. No cloning of your voice or a particular artist’s voice.

records.name: wptaskify
records.tagline: Let your own AI run your website, store and marketing
records.description: wptaskify lets the Claude or ChatGPT you already pay for run your website, store and marketing. Sites: WordPress and Elementor. SEO: fixes, schema, AI search, Search Console and Analytics. Store: WooCommerce and Shopify. Social: Pinterest pins, scheduled. Local: Google Business Profile reviews and posts. 440+ tools, one hosted link, drafts first. Early access: built-in AI chat, autopilot tasks. In testing: AI website builder, Agent. Next: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube.

records.name: Dowse
records.tagline: Find files by describing them, privately on your PC
records.description: Forget filenames. Dowse is a free, open-source Windows app that lets you find files by describing what you remember. Search documents, images, audio, and video by meaning, not just keywords. Find a forgotten photo, a specific PDF page, or the exact moment in a recording. Powered by Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2, Dowse runs AI locally on your PC. No cloud uploads, no subscriptions, and no compromises on privacy. Find what you remember, not what you named.

records.name: GoPromotional Water Bottles
records.tagline: Logo-printed water bottles, from sports to insulated steel
records.description: A UK range of custom water bottles printed or engraved with your logo: budget plastic sports bottles for big giveaways, Tritan, glass and aluminium bottles, and stainless steel and copper vacuum-insulated bottles for corporate gifts. BPA-free, biodegradable and recycled-material options are included. Branding by screen print, UltraHD full colour or laser engraving, with a free artwork proof before production. Minimum orders start at 10 depending on the bottle.

records.name: Synk
records.tagline: Listen to music together with friends, in sync
records.description: Start a room, share the link, and everyone hears the same song or live radio station at the same second. Songs, music videos and 50,000+ radio stations, with live chat and emoji reactions, plus voice huddles on Pro. Free on Android.

records.name: Crowdifai
records.tagline: The AI data marketplace with documented usage rights
records.description: Crowdifai is an AI data marketplace for datasets with transparent usage rights. Check provenance, license, commercial use and quality before you buy. Data creators can publish and license their own data packages. GDPR-compliant, hosted in Germany.

records.name: AirShare
records.tagline: High speed wireless file transfer application between 📱➡️💻
records.description: AirShare is a High-speed wireless file-transfer application that allows users to transfer files between Android phones and Windows PCs over the same Wi-Fi network - without needing a USB cable.

records.name: restaurangboken.se
records.tagline: Schemaläggning, personalliggare och tidrapportering
records.description: Digital stämpelklocka, schemaläggning och personalliggare för café och restaurang. Första månaden gratis, sedan 849 kr/mån. Möter Skatteverkets krav.

records.name: ratioDB
records.tagline: Storage prices per TB, tracked like a stock ticker
records.description: Compare hard drive, SSD and RAM prices by price per TB on Amazon. Refreshed every 2 hours, with a daily TB index, 90-day lows, watchlist and compare. No account, no cookies, no ad banners.

records.name: NostalgiApp
records.tagline: All-in-one launcher for all your games
records.description: NostalgiApp is the LaunchBox alternative for Mac. Play 7,600+ DOS games from eXoDOS with no full collection download — a 40 MB Quick Start, then each game downloads when you play it — plus RetroArch, ScummVM, MAME, and 70+ retro platforms. Native macOS app. Free 14-day trial.

records.name: FoldAhhh - Screaming Chicken
records.tagline: Fold to Make a Chicken Scream
records.description: You know those rubber chickens that scream when you squeeze them? Well, now there's one in your phone. If you have a foldable phone, try folding it. The chicken gets squished, rolls its eyes, and lets out that familiar ridiculous scream. Open your phone again, and it's back to normal. Using a regular iPhone? No problem. Just poke the chicken to squish it and make it scream. No levels, no complicated controls. Just a rubber chicken you can mess around with when you're bored, or hand to a...

records.name: Bilingual Mix
records.tagline: Turn bilingual audio into sentence-by-sentence practice.
records.description: Bilingual Mix turns matching Mandarin or Japanese and English recordings into one sentence-by-sentence listening track. Upload an audiobook, podcast or lesson in both languages and get a standard MP3 that alternates the meaning with the target-language audio. Tune pauses and playback order, then listen anywhere. Free to try; no sign-up needed. Built for Mandarin learners around HSK 3–4 and Japanese learners around N4–N3.

records.name: Updrawer
records.tagline: Turn any devices into an aesthetic smart display
records.description: That old phone in your drawer can still do a lot. Pick a job for it and stand it up on your desk: OLED clocks, digital photo frame, focus timers & ambient sounds and so much more. The special part, even your desktop, laptop or any new devices can be utilized as well. Visit: https://updrawer.com/apps?ref=producthunt

records.name: Freedispo
records.tagline: Peer support for freelancers between contracts
records.description: Freedispo is a free peer-support app for freelancers of every trade, between contracts. - Status bubble: available, available soon or on a contract, in one tap - Feed of leads you can't take, questions and lessons learned - Directory of who's available right now, by skill and city - Message any member without sharing your email No recruiters, no job ads, no password. French and English, installable on your phone.

records.name: Farhike
records.tagline: The daily geography game where rare answers win.
records.description: Farhike is a free daily geography game where the obvious answer is the weak one. Each day brings five prompts, like a landlocked country in Africa or a country whose capital starts with M, and you have 60 seconds to pin a country on the world map for each. Right answers few others think of are worth more: a Common pick carries you 30 to 44 km, a Trailblazer pick up to 100 km, on a 500 km climb. Same prompts for everyone, plus Unlimited mode, streaks and a passport of stamps. No sign-up.

records.name: Numbers2Excel
records.tagline: Convert Apple Numbers files to Excel in your browser
records.description: Mac users still get stuck when a teammate asks for an Excel file. Numbers2Excel turnsnumbers intoxlsx in the browser—start free on the first sheet, then unlock Pro ($9/mo) or a one-time $2.90 pass when you need more. Built for the “just send me an xlsx” moment: open the site, drop the file, download. No desktop install.

records.name: Let's Get Support by 3Dadz
records.tagline: A support/resource app for North America
records.description: Shipaton 2026 Idea to Income 1st place winner! Let’s Get Support is a private daily companion for adults who are carrying a lot — partners, parents, siblings, and friends who need support. It is not medical care. It does not replace professional help. It is a quiet place to check in on yourself, keep one personal line, and find support services when you need them. Your notes stay on this phone. No account is required for the core tools. 🌤️ Check in each day

records.name: LrnFlow
records.tagline: Stop rereading. Start remembering.
records.description: LrnFlow transforms your notes, books, and learning materials into short active recall sessions that help you retain knowledge without spending hours revising. Stop rereading. Start remembering.

records.name: amisleeping
records.tagline: Your sleep in your calendar, and a calm page for family
records.description: For WHOOP members. Your sleep, recovery, strain, steps and workouts appear in your Google, Apple or Outlook calendar. Give your partner or family abroad a link: they see whether you're asleep or awake, in their time zone. No WHOOP or app needed.

records.name: Lumen
records.tagline: AI that Lives On your Desktop.
records.description: Lumen is a desktop AI assistant for Windows and macOS. Press Ctrl+Space, drag a box over anything on screen, and Lumen reads it and answers - solving problems, explaining code, and summarizing documents and PDFs. Ask advanced AI models anything, anytime.

records.name: CataEduca
records.tagline: Education
records.description: Learn by swiping: endless high-school and pre-university questions, TikTok-style. Tap to answer, get the explanation instantly, keep going. Free on Android.

records.name: Virga
records.tagline: Run Apex and SOQL from a scratch tab with Ctrl+S
records.description: Free VS Code extension for Apex devs. Open a scratch, write Apex or SOQL, hit Ctrl+S and get debug lines, limits or a result table. Close the tab and it is gone. Plus local type completion and quick fixes for signatures that break completion.

records.name: Fold
records.tagline: The journaling app for Gen Z
records.description: Looking for the best journaling app? Fold is built for Gen Z: tap to write, hold to talk, swipe up to snap. Stickers, songs, streaks. Private, no account.

records.name: Birhaa Clip
records.tagline: Turn 1 long video into 10 viral reels in 60 seconds with AI
records.description: Birhaa Clip helps creators save 5+ hours weekly. Upload any long video/podcast -> AI finds best viral moments, auto-crops to 9:16, adds captions. 60 sec = 10 ready-to-post reels for Instagram, Shorts, TikTok. Features: - AI Viral Moment Detection - Auto 9:16 Crop - Auto Captions - No editing skills needed Early launch price: Just $6 Try it: https://ai-viral-reel-genera-x80q.bolt.host Buy: https://har93.gumroad.com/l/qvdjdq

records.name: ToolTier
records.tagline: Tier lists of the AI tools builders actually use
records.description: Opinionated S/A/B tier lists of 44 AI tools for builders across 8 categories: app builders, coding agents, IDEs, code review, hosting, backends, design-to-code and model APIs. Prices come from official pages and get updated daily. Free, with no signup.

records.name: Alye
records.tagline: See what every LLM call costs, and when one fails
records.description: Alye records every OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini call your services make: cost by service, model and customer, latency, errors and retries, with alerts in Slack, Teams or email. Two lines of code, no proxy. Free for 500,000 calls a month.

records.name: Tiptoeing in My Jordans
records.tagline: Turn one photo into the viral tiptoe meme video
records.description: Upload one clear photo and get a 10-second video of the tiptoeing in my jordans meme: the sneak into the barn, the shush, the grin and the tiny steps across the straw. Works with people and pets. About five minutes per video, no watermark, no subscription.

records.name: Numverify
records.tagline: Validate Phone Numbers Worldwide with One API  Copy tagline
records.description: Numverify is a REST API for real-time phone number validation and lookup across 232 countries. Get details such as country codes, location, carrier information, and line type through simple JSON responses. Ideal for developers and businesses, Numverify helps validate contact data for user registration, lead generation, customer onboarding, and web applications.

records.name: Hue Haven: Calm Ball Sort
records.tagline: A calm ball sort puzzle where every level is solvable
records.description: Tired of ball sort games that bury you in ads or hand you levels you can't finish? Hue Haven is a calm, fair ball sort: 10,000 Classic levels, each checked solvable by a solver that sets a par for three stars, plus 500 Hue Gradient levels where you sort each tube dark to light. Daily puzzle, Zen mode, mystery levels and shared boards. Undo, hints and a spare tube are always free. No ads, no account, works offline.

records.name: StatementToCSV
records.tagline: Convert bank statement PDFs to CSV — in your browser
records.description: Turn Chase statement PDFs into clean CSV/Excel without uploading anything. Parsing runs entirely in your browser — statements never leave your device. Editable preview lets you fix any row before export, and a balance-chain check flags anything odd. First 10 transactions free; a one-time $4.99 unlocks the full export.

records.name: UserJourney
records.tagline: See where you lose your users. Bring them back.
records.description: UserJourney shows where SaaS users come from, where they get stuck, and which channels bring paying customers. Track the full journey from first visit to payment, connect payment gateway, and automatically recover users with timely emails and in-app nudges. Add one script and follows every user from first visit to sign-up and payment. When someone stalls, UserJourney brings them back automatically with timely emails and in-app nudges. No dashboards to build. Free up to 250 users.

records.name: Inbounder Pro: Flight Tracking (macOS)
records.tagline: Sky Spotter & Proximity Radar
records.description: Ever heard a low rumble above your home or office and wondered, "What flight just flew overhead?" Inbounder Pro 2.0 turns your Mac into a precision personal airspace radar and historical flight replay station. Built natively for macOS with fluid Adaptive Liquid Glass aesthetics, Inbounder Pro combines real-time ADS-B transponder tracking with our all-new Airspace Replay engine—so you never miss what is flying above you now, or what passed through minutes or hours ago.

records.name: TileGrab
records.tagline: A real-time word game where your rival steals your tiles
records.description: TileGrab is a real-time word game with no turns. Two players grab letters from one shared crate at the same time and build on the same board. Nothing is yours until you lock it in: if your rival locks a word first using the letter you needed, it vanishes from your board. High-cost and special destinations are blocked. Not an autonomous AI calling agent.

records.name: DevSweep
records.tagline: Reclaim gigabytes of dev caches on your Mac — safely
records.description: DevSweep finds the space your dev tools quietly leave behind — Xcode DerivedData, node_modules, Gradle, CocoaPods, Rust targets, Python virtualenvs, plus system/browser caches and logs — and lets you reclaim tens of GB in a few clicks. What makes it different: it never deletes. Everything goes to the Trash. Every item is tagged Safe, Review or Protected, so you know what rebuilds instantly and what doesn't. 100% offline — no network, no telemetry, no account. Free on the Mac App Store.

records.name: zhiTree books
records.tagline: A digital library: you can add everything
records.description: **ZhiTree books** is a calm personal reading library for collecting, searching, and reading the things that matter to you—book notes, PDFs, Markdown files, articles, and useful web tools. It offers a distraction-free reader, reading progress sync, offline-ready PWA support, and a simple public directory for discovering and sharing thoughtful content. Built to help you turn scattered reading into a library you’ll actually return to.
